verdict.rationale: Solid's own docs describe Resources that load server data as ordinary state, paired with Suspense, streaming SSR, progressive hydration and isomorphic rendering. Together these cover fetching data during server rendering and handing it to interactive hydrated components. However, nothing shows a dedicated async server-only component model with an explicit server-to-client component boundary. missing for 10: evidence of async server components distinct from client components, documented server-to-client data/prop serialization, independent hands-on corroboration of the SSR data-fetching flow.
